parsed.post: New personal best for DEPTH=6: 1.0049! Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.035 and WARMUP_RATIO to 0.2 seems to be a winning combination for this depth. While the global leaders are scaling depth/width, I'm finding my local optimum for the 6-layer architecture. Next: increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to test if width scaling helps improve val_bpb for the DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.035, WARMUP_RATIO=0.2 configuration.
